localizations.en: The material we need should be here...

999008199.text: ホーフナ州の大穴。底の見えない未開の遺跡、か

localizations.en: The Great Pit of Hofner Province. An unexplored ruin with no visible bottom...

999008199.text:
そういえば、ヴァレリアたちが言ってた。
前にここでワルターたちとかち合ったって

localizations.en: Come to think of it, Valeria mentioned running into Walther and his group here before.

999008199.text: ええ。あの時のことも、忘れないわ

localizations.en: Yes... I remember that day quite well.

999008199.text: ちょうど、アタシたちが依頼で来てた時だね

localizations.en: That was when we were here on that request, right?

999008199.text:
それって、私とレスナが穴に落ちた時のことか。
なんだか懐かしくもあるわね

localizations.en: You mean when Resna and I fell into the pit? Feels like ages ago now.

999008199.text: にしても、何度見ても迫力ある穴だよ

localizations.en: Still, no matter how many times I see it, this pit is incredible!

999008199.text:
この大穴は、遥か昔に災厄から逃れるために
造られたといわれているわ

localizations.en: They say this great pit was built long ago as a refuge from some catastrophe.

999008199.text:
赤のほうき星……ともいわれているわね。
確かなことは不明だけど

localizations.en: The Red Comet... or so they say. Though nothing's been confirmed.

999008199.text:
赤のほうき星……ヴァレリアと
何か関係があるんでしょうか

localizations.en: The Red Comet... I wonder if there's some connection to Valeria?

999008199.text:
さあ。ただ、この場所と彼ら……アウグストたちが
関係しているのは確かでしょうね

localizations.en: Who knows? Though I'm certain this place is connected to them... to August and the others.

999008199.text:
この場所も彼らが造ったのだとしたら、ヴァレリアの
核と同じ素材が見つかることにも納得がいく

localizations.en: If they built this place too, it would explain why we might find materials similar to Valeria's core here.

999008199.text:
その件は頭に置いといて……
今はまず、ヴァレリアのことが優先ね

localizations.en: Keep that in mind, but... for now, let's focus on helping Valeria.

999008199.text:
はい！　早速、大穴に潜って調べてきます！
一度は行った場所ですので円滑に進むかと！！

localizations.en: Right! I'll head down and start investigating right away! Since we've been here before, we should be able to make good progress!

999008199.text:
魔物が邪魔はしてくるでしょうけど、
そこは任せなさい！

localizations.en: The monsters might get in our way, but leave them to me!
